description: Covers terminal emulator software and its input, rendering, compatibility, features, and emulator-specific security. Excludes shell and CLI utilities, and terminal multiplexers unless emulation is central.

name: Software architecture and system design
description: Covers software-system architecture and design tradeoffs, including component and service boundaries, modularity, monoliths and microservices, and system design. Excludes team management and delivery practices, and programming-language or compiler design.

name: OpenAI company and governance
description: Covers OpenAI's leadership, corporate governance, internal organization and culture, business deals, and company conduct. Excludes general AI ethics or policy, model capabilities, and ChatGPT product coverage unless an OpenAI corporate decision is central.

name: Military drones and counter-UAS
description: Covers military uncrewed aerial vehicles and aircraft, loitering munitions, military drone operations and procurement, and systems designed to detect or defeat military drones, including their use in Russia's war against Ukraine. Excludes hobbyist drone builds, civilian drone applications, and crewed aviation.

name: Raspberry Pi computers and ecosystem
description: Covers Raspberry Pi single-board computers, official hardware and accessories, platform-specific software and projects, and organization or company developments directly concerning the Raspberry Pi platform. Excludes general Linux, embedded-computing, or maker stories where Raspberry Pi is incidental.

name: Sleep science and health
description: Covers sleep research and its effects on health, cognition, and behavior, including sleep disorders, sleep deprivation, and sleep-related interventions. Excludes general productivity or wellness advice unless sleep is central.

name: Hong Kong politics and civil liberties
description: Covers Hong Kong's political governance, civil liberties, protest movements, and political repression, including developments affecting Hong Kong residents abroad. Excludes general Chinese domestic affairs and Hong Kong topics unrelated to politics or civil liberties.

name: Local language models and on-device inference
description: Covers running and managing language models on personal computers, mobile devices, browsers, and other user-controlled or edge hardware, including local inference runtimes and deployment tools. Excludes model research and training, cloud-hosted model infrastructure, and chatbot applications unless local inference is central.

name: YouTube platform and creator ecosystem
description: Covers YouTube-specific platform features, advertising and subscriptions, creator tools and economics, channel access, and user experience. Excludes general video creation or streaming-industry stories not substantially about YouTube.

name: Chess and competitive chess
description: Covers chess as a competitive activity, including players, tournaments, chess platforms, chess engines, and chess-specific games or analysis. Excludes other board games and general sports analytics not focused on chess.

name: China's foreign policy and strategic competition
description: Covers China's external strategic and security relations, including geopolitical rivalry, military competition, and technology or resource statecraft. Excludes cross-strait relations with Taiwan, China's domestic economy and demographics, and China-related stories without a substantial foreign-policy or strategic-competition focus.

name: Scientific misconduct and research integrity
description: Covers scientific fraud and misconduct, including fabrication, falsification, plagiarism, manipulated references, retractions, investigations, and accountability. Excludes general debates about peer review or research institutions unless a specific integrity violation is central.

name: Open-source AI models and ecosystems
description: Covers open-source or open-weight AI foundation models and their release, licensing, development, and model-specific serving ecosystems. Excludes general open-source governance, model research not centered on open models, and local inference tooling unless open-model availability or ecosystem is central.

name: AI industry economics and investment
description: Covers the business and financial economics of the AI industry, including investment and infrastructure spending, revenue and profitability, returns on AI investment, and market assessments of an AI boom or bubble. Excludes AI model capabilities, chip design, and general market coverage unless AI-industry economics is central.

name: Russian internet censorship and state control
description: Covers Russian state censorship and control of internet services, communications, and digital infrastructure, including blocking services and repression of internet advocates. Excludes Russia's war against Ukraine unless internet controls are directly tied to that war.

name: Authorization and access control
description: Covers authorization systems and policies that determine what users or services may access, including roles, permissions, and row-level access controls. Excludes authentication and identity verification unless authorization is central.

name: Alzheimer's disease and dementia
description: Covers research, diagnosis, prevention, treatment, and health effects centered on Alzheimer's disease or dementia. Excludes general neuroscience and aging research unless dementia is central.

name: Digital preservation and disappearing online archives
description: Covers the loss, shutdown, or preservation of websites, online publications, and other digital collections. Excludes general archival history and preservation of physical artifacts unless digital content is central.

name: Amateur fusion reactor building
description: Covers hobbyist and amateur projects to build or operate nuclear-fusion reactors, including personal experimental fusors. Excludes professional fusion research, commercial reactors, and general fusion science not centered on amateur builds.

name: Email systems and services
description: Covers email providers, mail delivery and infrastructure, email APIs, and operating email services. Excludes encrypted messaging and email privacy unless email services themselves are central, and excludes general authentication or web infrastructure.

name: Software observability and monitoring
description: Covers software observability practices and tools, including application and infrastructure monitoring, telemetry, tracing, and observability stacks. Excludes general system performance or reliability topics unless monitoring or observability is central.

name: AI coding assistants and editors
description: Covers AI coding tools and editors that generate, complete, explain, or modify code, including their features, workflows, integrations, and comparisons. Excludes tools centered on reviewing code or pull requests, Claude Code-specific coverage, and broader discussion or practice of vibe coding, which have separate topics.

name: Civilian drones and applications
description: Covers non-military drone applications and operations, including commercial delivery, emergency response, environmental monitoring, and public services. Excludes military or counter-UAS systems, hobbyist drone builds, and crewed aviation.

name: Sports betting and wagering
description: Covers sports betting markets, companies, products, regulation, and effects on bettors and consumers. Excludes competitive sports and sports analytics unless wagering is central, and gambling unrelated to sports.

name: Telegram platform and ecosystem
description: Covers Telegram as a messaging platform, including its features, security and encryption, governance, business, and role in public communication. Excludes general messaging technology and state censorship unless Telegram is central.

name: AI system security and prompt injection
description: Covers attacks against AI models, agents, and AI-enabled applications, including prompt injection, data exfiltration, and defenses specific to those systems. Excludes general software vulnerabilities and security tools unless AI-system security is central.

name: Geology and geophysics
description: Covers Earth's solid structure and physical processes, including geophysics, seismology, earthquakes, and geological materials. Excludes climate science, astronomy, and planetary geology unless Earth processes are central.

name: Time-tracking software
description: Covers software for recording, reviewing, and reporting time spent on personal or professional activities, including standalone timers and time-tracking workflows. Excludes general task or project management unless time tracking is central.

name: LLM inference serving and deployment
description: Covers infrastructure, tools, and operational techniques for serving and deploying language-model inference, including throughput, scaling, and deployment options. Excludes model architecture research, on-device local inference, and general cloud infrastructure unless LLM inference serving is central.

name: Personal fitness and health tracking
description: Covers consumer apps, wearables, and services for tracking personal fitness activity or health metrics. Excludes general medical diagnosis and treatment, fitness advice, and device coverage where tracking is incidental.

name: Web history and independent web culture
description: Covers the history and cultural evolution of the web, including the small, independent, and user-built web. Excludes personal blog publishing, feed aggregation, and federated social networks unless web history or independent-web culture is central.

name: Desktop environments and window management
description: Covers desktop shells, window managers, and tools for arranging or customizing desktop workspaces across operating systems. Excludes general-purpose GUI frameworks and desktop utilities unless workspace or window management is central.

name: Personal finance software and budgeting
description: Covers software for personal budgeting, expense tracking, financial planning, and tracking personal savings, debt, or investments. Excludes payment infrastructure, banking policy, and public-market analysis unless personal finance software is central.

name: Starlink satellite internet
description: Covers Starlink's satellite internet service, user access, service partnerships, and effects of its network on communications. Excludes general SpaceX operations, satellite technology, and other satellite internet services unless Starlink is central.

name: Wrongful convictions and capital punishment
description: Covers wrongful convictions, exonerations, and the use or consequences of capital punishment, including cases and broader arguments about executing potentially innocent people. Excludes criminal-justice stories not substantially about wrongful conviction or capital punishment.

name: Image conversion and compression tools
description: Covers software for converting, compressing, and optimizing image files across formats. Excludes image editing, computer vision, generative imagery, and video codecs unless image conversion is central.

name: WordPress ecosystem governance
description: Covers governance, ownership, policy, and community control of the WordPress project and ecosystem, including disputes involving WordPress.org, Automattic, WP Engine, and project forks. Excludes routine WordPress publishing, site operation, and product tutorials unless governance is central.

name: Smartphone theft and anti-theft security
description: Covers smartphone theft as a distinct crime and consumer-security problem, including theft methods, access to stolen devices, and anti-theft protections. Excludes general smartphone hardware or software coverage, ordinary account authentication, and general policing or privacy stories unless phone theft is central.

name: Backup software and data protection
description: Covers backup strategies, software, and services for copying, versioning, encrypting, and restoring files or system data. Excludes general-purpose storage and filesystems unless backup or recovery is central.

name: Bluesky platform and ecosystem
description: Covers the Bluesky social network, its AT Protocol-based products and ecosystem, user experience, adoption, and tools or services specifically built around Bluesky. Excludes the Fediverse and other social platforms except where migration or interoperability with Bluesky is central.

name: Document parsing and extraction software
description: Covers software and methods for extracting, parsing, and converting content from documents such as PDFs into structured or usable data. Excludes website scraping, general PDF editing, and personal document organization unless document parsing or extraction is central.

name: Prediction markets
description: Covers markets whose contracts forecast real-world events or outcomes, including their market mechanisms, platforms, and uses for forecasting or information aggregation. Excludes sports wagering, general securities investing, and cryptocurrency markets unless prediction contracts are central.

name: Cloud provider costs and migration
description: Covers comparisons of cloud-provider costs and capabilities, decisions to move workloads between providers or back on-premises, and the economics of cloud repatriation. Excludes routine AWS-specific deployment and operations, which belong in AWS and serverless infrastructure, unless provider comparison or migration is central.

name: Computational protein modeling and structure
description: Covers computational modeling of protein structure, flexibility, and biomolecular interactions, including molecular-dynamics and machine-learning methods when protein modeling is central. Excludes general machine-learning methods and molecular biology research not focused on computational protein modeling.

name: Timekeeping, time zones, and calendars
description: Covers civil timekeeping and its standards, systems, and practical consequences, including time zones, daylight saving time, leap seconds, and precision clocks. Excludes philosophical or fictional treatments of time unless timekeeping itself is central.

name: Task and project management software
description: Covers software and workflows for organizing, assigning, and tracking personal or team tasks and projects. Excludes time-tracking tools unless task or project management is central, and excludes general engineering management practices or methodologies.

name: Model Context Protocol (MCP)
description: Covers the Model Context Protocol specification and its ecosystem, including MCP clients, servers, tools, implementations, and integrations. Excludes general AI agents and tool-calling systems unless MCP is central.

name: Syrian politics and post-Assad transition
description: Covers Syria’s political transition, conflict, repression, humanitarian consequences, and regional or diplomatic developments when Syria is central. Excludes unrelated Middle Eastern affairs.

name: Tech immigration and H-1B visas
description: Covers immigration programs and policy affecting technology workers, especially H-1B visas, including eligibility, employer use, reform, and effects on workers. Excludes general employment stories unless tech-worker immigration is central.

name: U.S. federal government restructuring
description: Covers actions by the Trump administration and DOGE to reorganize, dismantle, or direct federal agencies, programs, workforce, and funding, and the resulting institutional disruptions. Excludes routine administration policy, ordinary political disputes, and unrelated regulatory actions.

name: Software debugging
description: Covers the practice, tools, and experience of diagnosing and fixing software defects. Excludes software testing and quality assurance, vulnerability research, and performance optimization unless debugging is central.

name: Synthetic biology and engineered cells
description: Covers engineering biological systems, including synthetic cells, genetic circuits, and designed cellular sensing or behavior. Excludes ordinary genetic research, computational protein design, and applications where engineered biology is incidental.

name: Data-center infrastructure and construction
description: Covers the physical facilities and engineering of data centers, including their design, construction, capacity, siting, and facility operations. Excludes cloud-service infrastructure and stories primarily about the energy or resource impacts of AI computing.

name: Tariffs and international trade policy
description: Covers government-imposed tariffs and other trade barriers, including proposals, implementation, negotiations, retaliation, exemptions, and their direct effects on cross-border commerce and supply chains. Excludes general macroeconomic conditions or market movements unless a specific trade-policy measure is central.

name: Advertising and ad-supported media
description: Covers advertising markets and economics, advertiser and publisher decisions, ad placement and formats, ad-supported products or services, and antitrust cases centered on advertising-market or ad-tech structure. Excludes broader platform-governance disputes where advertising markets are incidental.

name: Reasoning language models
description: Covers research and engineering focused on language models designed or trained for multi-step reasoning, including their training methods, test-time reasoning, benchmarks, and reasoning-specific capabilities. Excludes general conversational-assistant product coverage and language-model research where reasoning is incidental.

name: Microcontrollers and embedded systems
description: Covers microcontroller boards, embedded firmware, peripheral interfacing, and projects where a microcontroller platform is central. Excludes Raspberry Pi platform stories when the Pi ecosystem is the subject, RISC-V ecosystem coverage, and DIY robotics or mechanical builds where the robot or fabrication is central.

name: AI cheating in job interviews
description: Covers candidates' use of AI to gain undisclosed assistance during job interviews and employers' efforts or policies to detect or prevent it. Excludes ordinary AI coding assistance outside interviews and general hiring or interview advice.

name: European digital sovereignty and technology independence
description: Covers European efforts to reduce reliance on foreign technology providers and infrastructure, including digital-sovereignty initiatives, European alternatives, and critical technology dependencies. Excludes European technology or startup stories without a substantial independence or sovereignty focus.

name: Humanoid robotics
description: Covers the development, capabilities, deployment, commercial prospects, and social implications of humanoid robots. Excludes non-humanoid professional robotics and hobbyist-built robots or maker projects.

name: Direct-to-device satellite cellular networks
description: Covers satellite systems that connect directly to ordinary mobile phones or integrate satellite coverage with terrestrial cellular networks, including carrier partnerships, technical interoperability, and deployment. Excludes satellite internet services requiring dedicated user terminals and general satellite or mobile-network coverage.

name: Google Gemini AI models and assistant
description: Covers Google's Gemini-branded general-purpose AI models and consumer assistant, including model releases, API access, and Gemini-specific assistant features. Excludes Gemini Code Assist and other coding tools, and Google AI products where Gemini is incidental.

name: DeepSeek models and company
description: Covers DeepSeek-specific model releases, technical capabilities, the organization and its business, and geopolitical developments centered on DeepSeek. Excludes general open-weight model ecosystems, inference tooling, and AI-industry economics unless DeepSeek itself is central.

name: Claude Code
description: Covers Anthropic's Claude Code product, including its features, usage, workflows, pricing, integrations, and comparisons with other coding tools. Excludes general AI coding tools unless Claude Code is central.

name: Vibe coding
description: Covers the practice and discussion of building software by directing AI tools with natural-language prompts, including its techniques, examples, critiques, and effects on software development. Excludes product-specific coverage of Claude Code and general AI coding-tool coverage where this practice is not central.

name: Java development
description: Covers the Java programming language and its development ecosystem, including the JVM, JDK releases, Java libraries, frameworks, tools, and Java-based projects. Excludes Kotlin or other JVM-language stories unless Java is central.

name: ADHD and neurodiversity
description: Covers ADHD diagnosis, treatment, lived experience, accommodations, and ADHD-specific support or tools. Excludes general psychology and brain research unless ADHD is central.

name: Digital reading tools
description: Covers software and workflows for reading digital books, including e-book readers, reading trackers, and tools for managing or annotating e-book highlights. Excludes literary discussion, general note-taking and knowledge-management tools, and hardware stories where digital reading is incidental.

name: AI model evaluation and benchmarking
description: Covers methods, benchmarks, and results for evaluating the capabilities, reliability, and performance of AI and machine-learning models or systems. Excludes evaluations centered specifically on reasoning-language-model research, conventional software testing, and general ML engineering where evaluation is incidental.

name: U.S. manufacturing and industrial capacity
description: Covers the state and development of U.S. manufacturing and industrial capacity, including deindustrialization, reshoring, domestic production constraints, and manufacturing-focused industrial policy. Excludes general trade or macroeconomic coverage unless U.S. manufacturing is central.

name: Prompt engineering and prompt management
description: Covers methods and tools for authoring, structuring, templating, parameterizing, and managing prompts for AI systems. Excludes ordinary use of conversational assistants, AI coding tools, and agent frameworks unless prompt design or management is central.

name: Digital privacy and data protection
description: Covers individuals’ privacy interests and the collection, use, retention, disclosure, and protection of personal data across technologies and services. Excludes law-enforcement surveillance as the central subject, platform-specific governance disputes, and security vulnerabilities or breaches unless personal-data privacy is central.

name: India–Pakistan conflict and relations
description: Covers military conflict, diplomatic crises, security competition, and disputes between India and Pakistan, including Kashmir and shared water resources. Excludes domestic affairs of either country unless directly connected to bilateral tensions.

name: Language-model research and training
description: Covers research on language-model architectures, pretraining, scaling, optimization, and model merging. Excludes reasoning-focused language-model research, covered separately, and product or application stories where model research is not central.

name: U.S. immigration policy and enforcement
description: Covers U.S. immigration policy and enforcement, including border controls, asylum, deportation, and visa policy when immigration is central. Excludes tech-worker immigration programs, covered separately, and education policy where immigration is incidental.

name: AI in education
description: Covers the use and effects of AI in schools, colleges, and other learning settings, including classroom adoption, teaching, academic integrity, assessment, and student outcomes. Excludes programming education and stories where AI is incidental to the educational subject.

name: AI browser agents and automation
description: Covers AI agents that navigate websites or operate browsers to complete tasks, including browser-based automation products and their interfaces. Excludes general AI-agent frameworks and conventional browser software unless AI-driven browser automation is central.

name: AI code review
description: Covers AI tools and workflows that review source code or pull requests for defects, quality, or improvement. Excludes general AI code editors and assistants unless code review is central, and conventional software testing unless AI code review is central.

name: Weather forecasting and meteorology
description: Covers weather forecasting methods, systems, models, and services, including AI-based forecasting and forecast delivery. Excludes climate-change research and general time-series forecasting unless weather forecasting is central.

name: Online age verification and age assurance
description: Covers laws, systems, and disputes about verifying or estimating users’ ages to restrict minors’ access to online services or content. Excludes broader child online-safety policy unless age checks are central, and excludes identity systems used for purposes unrelated to age assurance.

name: Software and hardware reverse engineering
description: Covers methods and projects that inspect undocumented software, firmware, hardware, or protocols to understand their operation or reproduce their behavior, including binary analysis and logic-chip reverse engineering. Excludes vulnerability research when finding or exploiting a security flaw is central, ordinary debugging, and hardware teardowns or reviews.

name: Smart glasses and AI eyewear
description: Covers lightweight wearable glasses designed for everyday use, including camera, audio, display, and AI features, as well as their products, platforms, and markets. Excludes immersive VR and AR headsets, which belong in Virtual and augmented reality.

name: Stablecoins and tokenized money
description: Covers stablecoins and other fiat-pegged digital currencies, including their issuance, payment use, markets, adoption, and regulation. Excludes cryptocurrency topics where stablecoins are incidental and tokenization unrelated to stable-value digital money.

name: AI deep research systems
description: Covers AI tools and systems that conduct multi-step research across sources and synthesize findings, including deep-research assistants, APIs, and user workflows. Excludes general-purpose agent frameworks, ordinary search engines, and model research unless AI-powered research is central.
